learning_outcomes.text: Students name basic business administration terms and functions. They can describe influencing criteria from company foundation, through company management to company development and reproduce the basics of personnel planning, management, and motivation.
Students are able to deepen their knowledge beyond the discipline. They can discuss company types and legal forms, as well as company performance processes, and perform cost and revenue calculations.
Students can classify and assess strategic management tools and how location decisions are made.
Students can reflect on business administration aspects of engineering projects using case studies and possess the technical vocabulary to communicate with relevant professionals.

assessment_rules: The choice of examination type (oral or written) is at the discretion of the examiner and will be communicated to students at the beginning of the semester. For oral examinations, the duration is according to the valid general part of the examination regulations. For written examinations, the duration is according to the valid study regulations.
